SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_PR_EVAL_EXCEL_IMP EMP WHERE EMP.UPDT_USER = #UPDT_USER# AND EMP.SUBSD_CD = #SUBSD_CD#
EMP.RESULT_FLAG = #RESULT_FLAG#
SELECT NVL(SUM(1),0) ERR_CNT FROM EDU_PR_EVAL_EXCEL_IMP EMP WHERE EMP.UPDT_USER = #UPDT_USER# AND EMP.SUBSD_CD = #SUBSD_CD# AND EMP.ERROR_INFO IS NOT NULL

SELECT HD.DEPTNO AS PAY_AREA_CD, HD.ORG_NAME_LOCAL AS PAY_AREA_NAME, HD.PAY_AREA_CD AS PAY_AREA_CD_CODE,HD.ORDERNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HD, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN WHERE HD.DEPTNO = HDN.DEPTNO AND HD.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID# AND HDN.LANGUAGE = #language# AND HD.DEPT_LEVEL = 2 ORDER BY HD.ORDERNO

SELECT A.SUBJT_GR_ID AS CODE_NO, A.SUBJT_GR_NM AS CODE_NAME, A.SUBJT_GR_ID || ':' || A.SUBJT_GR_NM AS CODE_DESC FROM EDU_PR_SUBJT_GR A WHERE A.SUBSD_CD = #CPNY_ID# AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SUBSD_CD,A.SUBJT_GR_ID DESC
